mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS bindingId, b.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, cs.title AS courseTitle, cs.summary AS courseSummary, tc.id AS teachingClassId, tc.name AS className, tc.code AS classCode, t.name AS termName, ct.teacher_role AS teacherRole, ct.can_publish AS canPublish FROM edu_class_teacher ct JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = ct.teaching_class_id JOIN edu_term t ON t.id = tc.term_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.teaching_class_id = tc.id JOIN edu_course_space cs ON cs.id = b.course_space_id WHERE ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL AND ct.valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND ct.can_publish = 1 AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.starts_on DESC, cs.title, tc.name

SELECT b.id AS bindingId, b.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, cs.title AS courseTitle, cs.summary AS courseSummary, tc.id AS teachingClassId, tc.name AS className, tc.code AS classCode, t.name AS termName FROM edu_class_student st JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = st.teaching_class_id JOIN edu_term t ON t.id = tc.term_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.teaching_class_id = tc.id JOIN edu_course_space cs ON cs.id = b.course_space_id WHERE st.user_id = #{userId} AND st.left_at IS NULL AND st.joined_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.starts_on DESC, cs.title, tc.name

SELECT b.id AS bindingId, b.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, b.teaching_class_id AS teachingClassId, b.organization_id AS organizationId, cs.title AS courseTitle, tc.name AS className, ct.teacher_role AS teacherRole, ct.can_publish AS canPublish FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_course_space cs ON cs.id = b.course_space_id JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = b.teaching_class_id JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id = tc.id WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} AND ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL AND ct.valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND ct.can_publish = 1 AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.ended_at IS NULL

SELECT b.id AS bindingId, b.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, b.teaching_class_id AS teachingClassId, cs.title AS courseTitle, tc.name AS className, st.id AS enrollmentId FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_course_space cs ON cs.id = b.course_space_id JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = b.teaching_class_id JOIN edu_class_student st ON st.teaching_class_id = tc.id WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} AND st.user_id = #{userId} AND st.left_at IS NULL AND st.joined_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.ended_at IS NULL

SELECT b.id AS bindingId, b.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, b.teaching_class_id AS teachingClassId, b.organization_id AS organizationId, cs.title AS courseTitle, tc.name AS className FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_course_space cs ON cs.id = b.course_space_id JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT u.id AS unitId, u.parent_unit_id AS parentUnitId, u.unit_kind AS unitKind, u.title, u.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM edu_course_unit u WHERE u.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} ORDER BY u.sort_order, u.id
SELECT kp.id AS knowledgePointId, kp.unit_id AS unitId, kp.code, kp.name FROM edu_knowledge_point kp WHERE kp.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} ORDER BY kp.unit_id, kp.name

SELECT r.id AS resourceId, r.title, r.resource_kind AS resourceKind, r.status AS resourceStatus, rv.id AS versionId, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, DATE_FORMAT(rv.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource_page p WHERE p.resource_version_id = rv.id) AS pageCount, rel.id AS releaseId, DATE_FORMAT(rel.opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS opensAt, DATE_FORMAT(rel.closes_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS closesAt, rel.ended_at AS endedAt FROM edu_resource r LEFT JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.resource_id = r.id AND rv.version_no = (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM edu_resource_version v WHERE v.resource_id = r.id) LEFT JOIN edu_resource_class_release rel ON rel.resource_version_id = rv.id AND rel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND rel.ended_at IS NULL WHERE r.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND r.status <> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT r.id AS resourceId, r.title, rv.id AS versionId, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource_page p WHERE p.resource_version_id = rv.id) AS pageCount, DATE_FORMAT(rv.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt FROM edu_resource r JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.resource_id = r.id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.course_space_id = r.course_space_id JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} AND r.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL AND ct.can_publish = 1 AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rv.processing_status = 'READY' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC, rv.version_no DESC

SELECT rv.id AS versionId, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, DATE_FORMAT(rv.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource_page p WHERE p.resource_version_id = rv.id) AS pageCount FROM edu_resource_version rv WHERE rv.resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY rv.version_no DESC
SELECT page_no AS pageNo, preview_storage_key AS previewStorageKey, width_px AS widthPx, height_px AS heightPx FROM edu_resource_page WHERE resource_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY page_no

SELECT rv.id AS versionId, rv.resource_id AS resourceId, rv.resource_kind AS resourceKind, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, r.title, r.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId FROM edu_resource_version rv JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = rv.resource_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.course_space_id = r.course_space_id JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE rv.id = #{versionId} AND b.id = #{bindingId} AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL AND ct.can_publish = 1

SELECT rv.id AS versionId, rv.resource_id AS resourceId, rv.resource_kind AS resourceKind, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, r.title, r.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, rel.id AS releaseId FROM edu_resource_class_release rel JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.id = rel.resource_version_id JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = rel.resource_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.id = rel.binding_id JOIN edu_class_student st ON st.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE rel.id = (SELECT MAX(r2.id) FROM edu_resource_class_release r2 WHERE r2.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND r2.resource_version_id = rv.id AND r2.ended_at IS NULL) AND rel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND rel.resource_version_id = #{versionId} AND rel.ended_at IS NULL AND rel.opens_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (rel.closes_at IS NULL OR rel.closes_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND rv.processing_status = 'READY' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND st.user_id = #{userId} AND st.left_at IS NULL

SELECT rv.id AS versionId, rv.resource_id AS resourceId, rv.resource_kind AS resourceKind, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, r.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, r.title FROM edu_resource_version rv JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = rv.resource_id WHERE rv.id = #{versionId}

SELECT rel.id AS releaseId, rel.binding_id AS bindingId, rel.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, rel.resource_id AS resourceId, rel.resource_version_id AS resourceVersionId, rel.opens_at AS opensAt, rel.closes_at AS closesAt, rel.ended_at AS endedAt FROM edu_resource_class_release rel WHERE rel.id = #{releaseId}

SELECT rel.id AS releaseId, rel.resource_version_id AS resourceVersionId, rel.opens_at AS opensAt, rel.closes_at AS closesAt FROM edu_resource_class_release rel WHERE rel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND rel.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND rel.ended_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM edu_course_class_binding WHERE id = #{bindingId} FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO edu_resource_page (resource_version_id, resource_kind, page_no, preview_storage_key, width_px, height_px) VALUES (#{versionId}, 'FILE', #{pageNo}, #{previewStorageKey}, #{widthPx}, #{heightPx})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_resource_class_release (binding_id, course_space_id, resource_id, resource_version_id, released_by_user_id, released_at, opens_at, closes_at) VALUES (#{bindingId}, #{courseSpaceId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceVersionId}, #{userId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), #{opensAt}, #{closesAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS resourceId, r.title, rv.id AS versionId, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rel.id AS releaseId, DATE_FORMAT(rel.opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS opensAt, DATE_FORMAT(rel.closes_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS closesAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource_page p WHERE p.resource_version_id = rv.id) AS pageCount FROM edu_resource_class_release rel JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = rel.resource_id JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.id = rel.resource_version_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.id = rel.binding_id JOIN edu_class_student st ON st.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE rel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND rel.ended_at IS NULL AND rel.opens_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (rel.closes_at IS NULL OR rel.closes_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND rv.processing_status = 'READY' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND st.user_id = #{userId} AND st.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY rel.opens_at DESC, rel.id DESC

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.title, q.status, qv.id AS versionId, qv.version_no AS versionNo, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.stem, qv.options_json AS optionsJson, qv.answer_json AS answerJson, qv.explanation, qv.max_score AS maxScore, DATE_FORMAT(qv.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(kp.name ORDER BY kp.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM edu_question_knowledge_point qkp JOIN edu_knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = qkp.knowledge_point_id WHERE qkp.question_id = q.id) AS knowledgePoints FROM edu_question q JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.question_id = q.id AND qv.version_no = (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM edu_question_version v WHERE v.question_id = q.id) WHERE q.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND q.status <> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY q.created_at DESC, q.id DESC

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.title, qv.id AS versionId, qv.version_no AS versionNo, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.stem, qv.max_score AS maxScore FROM edu_question q JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.question_id = q.id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.course_space_id = q.course_space_id JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} AND q.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL AND ct.can_publish = 1 AND q.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY q.created_at DESC, q.id DESC, qv.version_no DESC

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, q.title, qv.id AS versionId, qv.version_no AS versionNo, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.stem, qv.options_json AS optionsJson, qv.answer_json AS answerJson, qv.explanation, qv.max_score AS maxScore FROM edu_question_version qv JOIN edu_question q ON q.id = qv.question_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.course_space_id = q.course_space_id JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE qv.id = #{versionId} AND b.id = #{bindingId} AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL AND ct.can_publish = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_question (course_space_id, title, status, created_by_user_id) VALUES (#{courseSpaceId}, #{title}, 'ACTIVE', #{userId})

INSERT INTO edu_question_version (question_id, version_no, question_kind, stem, options_json, answer_json, explanation, rubric_json, max_score, created_by_user_id) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{versionNo}, #{questionKind}, #{stem}, #{optionsJson}, #{answerJson}, #{explanation}, NULL, #{maxScore}, #{userId})
INSERT IGNORE INTO edu_question_knowledge_point (question_id, course_space_id, knowledge_point_id) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{courseSpaceId}, #{knowledgePointId})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS lessonId, l.title, l.unit_id AS unitId, DATE_FORMAT(l.scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS scheduledAt, l.status FROM edu_lesson l WHERE l.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND l.status <> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY l.scheduled_at, l.id

SELECT l.id AS lessonId, l.binding_id AS bindingId, l.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, l.unit_id AS unitId, l.title FROM edu_lesson l WHERE l.id = #{lessonId} AND l.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND l.status <> 'ARCHIVED'

SELECT p.id AS planId, p.lesson_id AS lessonId, l.title AS lessonTitle, p.version_no AS versionNo, p.title, p.private_notes AS privateNotes, p.status, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt FROM edu_lesson_plan p JOIN edu_lesson l ON l.id = p.lesson_id AND l.binding_id = p.binding_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.id = p.binding_id JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE p.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL AND ct.can_publish = 1 AND b.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.lesson_id, p.version_no DESC

SELECT pm.id AS planMaterialId, pm.resource_id AS resourceId, pm.resource_version_id AS resourceVersionId, pm.sort_order AS sortOrder, pm.private_notes AS privateNotes, r.title, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource_page rp WHERE rp.resource_version_id = rv.id) AS pageCount FROM edu_plan_material pm JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = pm.resource_id JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.id = pm.resource_version_id WHERE pm.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY pm.sort_order

SELECT id AS templateId, template_kind AS templateKind, title, question_id AS questionId, question_version_id AS questionVersionId, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, status FROM edu_activity_template WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_lesson_plan (lesson_id, binding_id, version_no, title, private_notes, status, created_by_user_id) VALUES (#{lessonId}, #{bindingId}, #{versionNo}, #{title}, #{privateNotes}, #{status}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO edu_plan_material (plan_id, binding_id, course_space_id, resource_id, resource_version_id, sort_order, private_notes) VALUES (#{planId}, #{bindingId}, #{courseSpaceId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceVersionId}, #{sortOrder}, #{privateNotes})

INSERT INTO edu_activity_template (plan_id, binding_id, course_space_id, template_kind, title, question_id, question_version_id, duration_seconds, status, created_by_user_id) VALUES (#{planId}, #{bindingId}, #{courseSpaceId}, #{templateKind}, #{title}, #{questionId}, #{questionVersionId}, #{durationSeconds}, #{status}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, a.lesson_id AS lessonId, a.title, a.instructions, a.status, DATE_FORMAT(a.opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS opensAt, DATE_FORMAT(a.closes_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS closesAt, DATE_FORMAT(a.answer_opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS answerOpensAt, ai.id AS assignmentItemId, ai.question_id AS questionId, ai.question_version_id AS questionVersionId, qv.stem, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_assignment_target t WHERE t.assignment_id = a.id AND t.target_status = 'REQUIRED') AS targetCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM edu_assignment_submission s JOIN edu_assignment_target t2 ON t2.id = s.target_id WHERE t2.assignment_id = a.id) AS submissionCount FROM edu_assignment a LEFT JOIN edu_assignment_item ai ON ai.assignment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.id = ai.question_version_id WHERE a.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND a.assignment_kind = 'PREVIEW' ORDER BY a.opens_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, a.binding_id AS bindingId, a.title, a.instructions, a.status, DATE_FORMAT(a.opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS opensAt, DATE_FORMAT(a.closes_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS closesAt, DATE_FORMAT(a.answer_opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS answerOpensAt, ai.id AS assignmentItemId, ai.question_id AS questionId, ai.question_version_id AS questionVersionId, qv.stem, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.options_json AS optionsJson, qv.max_score AS maxScore, s.id AS submissionId, sv.version_no AS submittedVersion, DATE_FORMAT(sv.submitted_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS submittedAt FROM edu_assignment a JOIN edu_assignment_target t ON t.assignment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN edu_assignment_item ai ON ai.assignment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.id = ai.question_version_id LEFT JOIN edu_assignment_submission s ON s.target_id = t.id LEFT JOIN edu_submission_version sv ON sv.submission_id = s.id AND sv.superseded_at IS NULL JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.id = a.binding_id JOIN edu_class_student st ON st.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE a.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND a.assignment_kind = 'PREVIEW' AND t.student_user_id = #{userId} AND t.target_status = 'REQUIRED' AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND st.user_id = #{userId} AND st.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.opens_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, a.binding_id AS bindingId, a.title, a.instructions, a.status, a.opens_at AS opensAtRaw, a.closes_at AS closesAtRaw, a.answer_opens_at AS answerOpensAtRaw, DATE_FORMAT(a.opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS opensAt, DATE_FORMAT(a.closes_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS closesAt, DATE_FORMAT(a.answer_opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS answerOpensAt, t.id AS targetId, t.target_status AS targetStatus FROM edu_assignment a JOIN edu_assignment_target t ON t.assignment_id = a.id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.id = a.binding_id JOIN edu_class_student st ON st.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE a.id = #{assignmentId} AND a.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND a.assignment_kind = 'PREVIEW' AND t.student_user_id = #{userId} AND t.target_status = 'REQUIRED' AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND st.user_id = #{userId} AND st.left_at IS NULL

SELECT ai.id AS assignmentItemId, ai.prompt, ai.question_id AS questionId, ai.question_version_id AS questionVersionId, ai.max_score AS maxScore, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.options_json AS optionsJson,
qv.answer_json AS answerJson, qv.explanation,

1 AS answerVisible FROM edu_assignment_item ai LEFT JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.id = ai.question_version_id WHERE ai.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY ai.sort_order

SELECT t.id AS targetId, t.assignment_id AS assignmentId, t.student_user_id AS studentUserId, a.binding_id AS bindingId, a.teaching_class_id AS teachingClassId, a.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, a.status, a.opens_at AS opensAt, a.closes_at AS closesAt FROM edu_assignment_target t JOIN edu_assignment a ON a.id = t.assignment_id WHERE t.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND t.student_user_id = #{userId} AND t.target_status = 'REQUIRED' FOR UPDATE

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM edu_assignment_submission s JOIN edu_assignment_target t ON t.id = s.target_id WHERE t.assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
